surface_value: Lung nodules are not commonly found after Bendeka and Rituxan therapy. Lung nodules are commonly found during routine x-rays, showing up on one in every 500 x-rays. Most are benign (noncancerous). Interstitial lung disease is considered a rare complication of Bendeka plus rituximab therapy but one that doctors should monitor for because it may be potentially fatal.
